title: Northgate Optical Refund Accounting: Option Cancellation Refund
content:
**Which option charge is being refunded.** The option charges of a Northgate Optical job cancelled in the lab are settled one at a time in a fixed order: the option being refunded is the first of the light-adaptive, the blue-light filtering and the anti-reflective option charge that carries no cancellation refund yet. An option counts in this order only where a charge for it was posted on the job.

**The refund.** The option cancellation refund of the option being refunded in an in-lab cancellation is that option charge less every credit already posted against it, refunded in full, less an option handling fee of 6.00, never less than zero, rounded to the cent. The net option charge is the charge for that option less every credit already posted against charges of that option.

**Order of working.** The option cancellation refund is worked out in this order: the refundable part of the net option charge is taken first, the option card courtesy is then added and the option handling fee deducted, and the result is floored at zero and rounded to the cent once.

| Line | Value |
|---|---|
| Refundable part of the net option charge | the net option charge in full |
| Option card courtesy | 0 percent of the net option charge |
| Option handling fee | 6.00 |
| Floor and rounding | floored at zero, rounded to the cent once |

## Worked figures (hypothetical job carrying a light-adaptive charge of 80.00 and an anti-reflective charge of 35.00, no credits)

| Settlement | Option being refunded | Net option charge | Less handling fee 6.00 | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| first | light-adaptive (no cancellation refund yet) | 80.00 | 74.00 | 74.00 |
| second | anti-reflective (the light-adaptive charge now carries its refund) | 35.00 | 29.00 | 29.00 |

A blue-light filtering charge of 30.00 on another job (hypothetical) gives 24.00; a net option charge of 4.00 gives 0.00, the result never falling below zero.
